items.title: Your bookmarks, right after an update
items.detail: The first new tab after an update shows your bookmarks again, and pages load whole as it starts.

items.title: Site icons that keep up
items.detail: A bookmark shows a site’s current icon: when a site changes its own, yours changes on your next visit.

items.title: Updates as it opens
items.detail: When a new version is out, the window opens on it with Update now, and its changes show here once it’s open.

items.title: What Exo Shield stopped
items.detail: A shield by the star counts the ads and trackers Exo Shield blocked on the page you’re on.

items.title: Tabs give their memory back
items.detail: A tab you leave for a minute gives most of its memory back, and still opens at once when you return.

items.title: Windows 11 scrollbars
items.detail: Thin scrollbars over the page, as Windows draws its own, and Reduce motion that only its own switch decides.

items.title: Smoother all round
items.detail: Split view opens with no black half, a quick reload never leaves a tab blank, and glass over a page is frosted all the way.

items.title: Faster where you feel it
items.detail: A new tab in 34 ms, Settings at once the first time, Search with no dropped frames, Exo Vault open sooner.

items.title: Lighter while you play
items.detail: Less memory for the graphics, quiet loops while a game is in front, and nothing written to disk for no reason.

items.title: Exo Vault, harder to read
items.detail: What you type into it stays out of the page, and an old master password opens nothing left behind.

items.title: Asks before it cannot be undone
items.detail: Clearing history or cookies, deleting a space, or emptying the vault’s trash asks first.

items.title: Updates from Exo
items.detail: Exo Browser looks for updates at Exo’s own address, with GitHub behind it, so they always find you.

items.title: Exo Vault stays open
items.detail: Closing Exo Browser no longer locks it. It locks when Windows locks, the PC sleeps or your Lock after time runs out.

items.title: Updates install again
items.detail: Install update in Settings › About starts Setup again and brings each new version in.

items.title: Off your stream
items.detail: While Exo Vault shows your logins, screen shares, recordings and screenshots leave Exo Browser out.

items.title: Actions on every result
items.detail: Right-click a result in Search, or press Tab: open it beside this tab, in Peek or privately, copy it clean, or close it.

items.title: Exo Shield, up to date
items.detail: The newest uBlock Origin Lite and today's HaGeZi list.

items.title: Out of your game's way
items.detail: While Exo Launcher runs a game, tabs you aren't looking at give their memory back and background checks wait.

items.title: Always up to date
items.detail: Exo Browser always looks for updates, as Exo Launcher does; nothing installs until you choose Install update.

items.title: Keep this tab
items.detail: Right-click a tab to keep it: it is never archived or put to sleep, so a chat or a player stays live.

items.title: An archive you can browse
items.detail: Settings › Archive lists the tabs it closed, to open again in the space they left or remove.

items.title: Archive after an hour
items.detail: Archive tabs can wait as little as an hour, and each space always keeps its five newest tabs.

items.title: One checkpoint for what leaves your PC
items.detail: Everything Exo Browser fetches on its own goes only where its privacy policy says.

items.title: Updates install themselves again
items.detail: Install update in Settings › About closes Exo Browser, puts the new version in place and opens it again.

items.title: Unlock Exo Vault where you are
items.detail: Type your master password right in the menu beside a sign-in field, or in the offer to save one.

items.title: Unlock and save in one go
items.detail: A sign-in offered while the vault is locked is saved as soon as you unlock it.

items.title: Boost this site opens on the site
items.detail: A tab's Boost this site goes straight to that site's own style and zaps.

items.title: Exo Vault works again
items.detail: Save, Not now and your saved logins take a click again, and sign-ins that open a new page are offered too.

items.title: Exo's newest glass
items.detail: Exo Launcher's latest glass, notices and icons, and Exo's own menu when you right-click a page.

items.title: Links without trackers
items.detail: Every page opens without the tracking tags and click ids links carry, and Copy link copies it clean.

items.title: Tabs stay ready
items.detail: With memory to spare, a tab you left keeps its page for an hour or more instead of 30 minutes.

items.title: Fits any window
items.detail: In a narrow window the Bar, Search, Settings and Exo Vault stay whole.

items.title: One Bar, like Exo Launcher
items.detail: The address, your tabs and the buttons share one row, so pages get more room.

items.title: Glass that frosts the page
items.detail: Scroll down and the page slides under the Bar, its glass frosting what passes beneath.

items.title: Spaces
items.detail: Keep work, school and play apart, each space with its own tabs, color and look.

items.title: Favorites and pinned tabs
items.detail: Favorites show in every space, and a pinned tab always goes back to its own page.

items.title: Bring everything from Arc
items.detail: Your Arc spaces, favorites, pinned and Today tabs come over, even after Arc shuts down.

items.title: Peek at a link
items.detail: Right-click a link and choose Open link in Peek to read it without leaving your page.

items.title: Split view
items.detail: Put up to four tabs side by side and work across them at once.

items.title: Links land in the right space
items.detail: Pick a space for a site, and its links from your other apps open there.

items.title: Private tabs
items.detail: Ctrl+Shift+N opens a tab that keeps nothing: no history, its own cookies, gone when you close it.

items.title: Search one site
items.detail: Type yt and a space to search YouTube, or a site's address and Tab. Add your own in Settings.

items.title: Ctrl+Tab goes back
items.detail: It goes through tabs in the order you used them, as Alt+Tab does with windows.

items.title: Zap and Boosts
items.detail: Right-click a tab to take things off a site for good, or give it a style of your own.

items.title: Little Exo
items.detail: Links from other apps can open in a small window of their own, and move into your tabs with one click.

items.title: Folders
items.detail: Keep pinned tabs in folders in the side tabs, or follow a site in a live folder that shows its newest posts.

items.title: Mods
items.detail: Themes in one click, small tweaks to the browser itself and your own CSS, in Settings › Mods.

items.title: Video follows you
items.detail: A video playing with sound floats over everything when you leave its tab.

items.title: Tabs that tidy themselves
items.detail: Turn on Archive tabs and the ones you haven't opened in a while close into the archive.

items.title: Downloads that always finish
items.detail: Every download shows when it's done, and no extra download bubble pops up.

items.title: Lighter on every page
items.detail: Scrolling costs a page nothing extra, the Bar and Settings draw only what changed, and a window left alone stays still.

items.title: Glass that moves as one
items.detail: The Bar, side tabs, menus and notices bring their frost with them, so nothing flashes gray or bare.

items.title: New tabs at once
items.detail: A new tab shows up the moment you open it, light in Light and black in Void.

items.title: A faster start
items.detail: The window and your tabs are there sooner every time Exo Browser opens.

items.title: Menus without a flash
items.detail: Menus, Search and Settings come in as one piece of clear glass.

items.title: Updates in one click
items.detail: Settings › About installs a new version and opens it again with your tabs as they were.

items.title: Exo Vault keeps your passwords
items.detail: Importing no longer brings other password managers along to fight over sign-in fields.
